newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC confident can cut nickel costs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC confident can cut nickel costs.

text.p: Base metals and gold miner WMC Ltd remained confident that its nickel production costs per unit would be reduced by 10 percent by June 30 this year, managing director Hugh Morgan said on Wednesday.
"We should get our 10 percent reduction by the 30th of June," Morgan told a news conference.
WMC announced the cost-cutting target late last year, but analysts have been sceptical about WMC's ability to meet the target.
WMC Ltd said earlier that earnings from its nickel division for the six months to December 31 fell to A$64.4 million from A$151.9 million in the previous corresponding period.
WMC said the fall was due to a combination of substantially lower realised nickel prices and a higher Australian dollar which was partially offset by higher production.
"It was also impacted by a one-off charge of A$8.4 million for workforce restructuring at Kambalda (nickel refinery)," WMC said.
The restructuring was due to a switch to independent contract mining services which saw WMC retrench about 445 workers.
